objective.text: Restrict web-server PHP execution to the Laravel front controller rather than every PHP file in the public tree.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish a correct document root from the separate policy selecting which PHP files may execute.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: The document root already points to public. A generic Nginx PHP location would execute any .php file placed there. The deployment must execute only Laravel’s index.php entry point and reject other PHP paths. Which policy meets that boundary?

options.text: Send every existing .php file under public to PHP-FPM.
options.rationale: The document root is correct but this still permits additional PHP files to execute.
options.misconception: The document root is correct but this still permits additional PHP files to execute.

options.text: Remove all PHP handling and serve those files as ordinary static content.
options.rationale: That prevents Laravel from executing and may disclose source rather than safely rejecting PHP paths.
options.misconception: That prevents Laravel from executing and may disclose source rather than safely rejecting PHP paths.

options.text: Allow the index.php entry-point location, then reject other PHP paths.
options.rationale: A narrow FastCGI entry point plus rejection of other PHP paths enforces the stated execution boundary.

options.text: Keep the generic PHP handler and reject extra PHP paths inside Laravel middleware.
options.rationale: A separate PHP script can execute without entering Laravel’s front controller or middleware.
options.misconception: A separate PHP script can execute without entering Laravel’s front controller or middleware.

explanation.summary: A narrow FastCGI entry point plus rejection of other PHP paths enforces the stated execution boundary.

validation.reason: Laravel official Nginx deployment example restricts FastCGI to the front controller and returns 404 for other PHP locations. No live Nginx instance is tested.
